import React, { useState } from 'react';
import * as W from '.';
import { Shape } from '../shapes';
import Theme, { Dark } from './Theme';

export default function Button({ label, onClick = noop }, [x, y] = []) {
  const [state, setState] = useState(0);
  return (
    <Theme.Provider value={Dark}>
      <W.Panel title={format(label)} onClick={() => setState(state + 1)}>
        <Icon name="x" />
        <Icon name="y" />
        <my-element />
        <div className="c">{label} {render(Shape)}</div>
        <>
          <Shape.Fragment />
        </>
      </W.Panel>
    </Theme.Provider>
  );
}

const Label = ({ text }) => <span>{text}<Icon /></span>;

export const Card = (props) => {
  return <Button label={props.label} />;
};

function noop() {}
